program.description: Python source file inside the workspace.

projectName.description: JDT project name for classpath resolution.

classPaths.description: Explicit application classpath, or omit to resolve from the project.

javaExec.description: Standalone Java executable used to run the application.

hotCodeReplace.description: Apply changed method bodies only when explicitly requested.

processId.description: Windows process ID of a Java JVM already listening for JDWP on 127.0.0.1. Use this field without hostName or port.

rocketbrain.sshWorkspace.profiles.description: Trusted SSH workspaces configured in user settings. Remote files require OpenSSH and a Python 3.8+ launcher on the host.

root.description: Existing absolute directory on the remote host.

knownHostsPath.description: Absolute local path to the verified OpenSSH known_hosts file.

privateKeyPath.description: Absolute local key path. Omit to use OpenSSH agent or default identities.

rocketbrain.acp.agents.description: Trusted local stable ACP v1 stdio programs configured by the user.

executable.description: Absolute path to a trusted agent executable.

rocketbrain.kubernetes.kubectlPath.description: Absolute path to the local kubectl executable. An empty value searches PATH.

rocketbrain.kubernetes.helmPath.description: Absolute path to the local Helm executable. An empty value searches PATH.

rocketbrain.devcontainer.cliPath.description: Absolute path to the installed @devcontainers/cli 0.91.0 package folder for local workspace containers.

rocketbrain.devcontainer.nodePath.description: Optional absolute path to the Node.js 20+ executable. Defaults to node on the local PATH.

rocketbrain.devcontainer.dockerPath.description: Optional absolute path to the Docker executable. Defaults to docker on the local PATH and requires a local Docker context.

rocketbrain.jupyter.pythonPath.description: Absolute path to local Python with jupyter_client and ipykernel for explicit notebook execution.

rocketbrain.python.path.description: Absolute path to the Python interpreter for local source inspection, tasks and debugpy.

rocketbrain.localCodeModel.endpoint.description: Numeric loopback URL ending in /v1/chat/completions for the local chat server.

rocketbrain.localCodeModel.model.description: Model name exposed by the configured local chat server.

rocketbrain.vue.nodePath.description: Absolute path to Node.js for workspace-local Vue tools. An empty value uses Node.js from PATH.

rocketbrain.vue.enableDefinitions.description: Load the installed Vue compiler and TypeScript in an independent Node process when finding Vue template definitions in this trusted workspace.

rocketbrain.sql.analysis.resolutionScope.description: Match a workspace-relative SQL file or a folder path ending with / to a local DDL catalog. The most specific path takes priority.

rocketbrain.java.inspectionProfiles.description: Named Java inspection profiles with source globs, per-rule severity and duplicate detection settings.

rocketbrain.sql.formatting.style.description: Choose whether ordinary SQL clauses wrap onto new lines or use compact spacing. Stored-program block indentation follows the SQL editor settings.

rocketbrain.sql.formatting.keywordCase.description: Change the case of recognized statement, clause and stored-program block keywords. Identifier and literal spelling stays exact.

rocketbrain.localSqlAssistant.endpoint.description: Explicit loopback HTTP Chat Completions URL for a local SQL model, such as http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1/chat/completions. Requests require review and confirmation.

rocketbrain.localSqlAssistant.model.description: Model identifier or alias served by the configured local endpoint.

rocketbrain.sql.templates.description: SQL templates with prefix, body and optional description. Context fields include relation, table, schema, columns and key.

rocketbrain.codeReview.provider.description: Repository host for the code-review workbench.

rocketbrain.codeReview.repository.description: GitHub owner/repository or GitLab group/project path.

rocketbrain.codeReview.endpoint.description: Optional API base URL for the selected provider.

rocketbrain.deploy.webdav.remoteDirector.description: Existing folder below the WebDAV endpoint.

rocketbrain.deploy.webdav.exclusions.description: Relative path patterns to skip when comparing deployment files.

rocketbrain.http.environments.description: Named sets of HTTP text variables. Store credentials with Set HTTP Environment Secret.

rocketbrain.java.enabled.description: Start Rocketbrain's directly connected Java language engine in trusted workspaces.

rocketbrain.java.staticImport.favorites.description: Static methods and fields JDT may suggest. Use a qualified member or a wildcard on a declaring type. Reviewed imports add the specific member.

rocketbrain.java.extractInterface.replac.description: Include compatible Java usage type changes in the Extract Interface diff. Reloads the Java language server when changed.

rocketbrain.java.serverPath.description: Absolute path to an independently downloaded Eclipse JDT Language Server distribution.

rocketbrain.java.javaHome.description: Absolute path to a standalone JDK 25 or later for the language server. Do not use an IDE's embedded runtime.

rocketbrain.editor.javaHints.description: Java parameter names and JDT-inferred variable and lambda parameter types.

rocketbrain.editor.kotlinHints.description: Kotlin parameter names and inferred types from the configured language server.

rocketbrain.java.fileTemplates.description: Java templates may target project tools and source kinds. Use ${name}, ${package}, ${packageDeclaration}, and declared ${variable.name} placeholders.

rocketbrain.java.copyrightProfiles.description: Reusable notice text for generated Java files with optional Maven, Gradle and source-kind restrictions. The notice accepts ${year}, ${name} and ${package}.

rocketbrain.java.defaultCopyrightProfile.description: Name of the preferred Java file copyright profile for compatible source roots.

rocketbrain.java.liveTemplates.description: Additional Java snippets with a prefix, body and optional description.

rocketbrain.java.postfixCompletion.description: Suggest Rocketbrain postfix transformations for reviewed Java expression shapes.

rocketbrain.java.gradleHome.description: Optional absolute path to an independently installed Gradle distribution for project import.

rocketbrain.java.gradleJavaHome.description: Optional standalone JDK path for importing Gradle projects.

rocketbrain.java.groovyConsoleJar.description: Optional absolute path to the verified official Apache Groovy 4.0.28 core JAR. The default uses the matching JAR in the configured Gradle home.

rocketbrain.java.annotationProcessing.gr.description: Enable JDT editor annotation processing for Gradle projects in trusted workspaces. Gradle build tasks use the project's build configuration.

nullable.description: Fully qualified nullable annotation for the custom profile.

nonnull.description: Fully qualified non-null annotation for the custom profile.

nonnullByDefault.description: Optional fully qualified default non-null annotation for the custom profile.

rocketbrain.java.nullChecks.description: Enable Eclipse JDT Java null diagnostics when the chosen annotations are present in the imported project.

rocketbrain.java.annotationProcessing.lo.description: Optional absolute path to the verified official Lombok 1.18.48 Java agent JAR for editor-generated symbols in trusted workspaces.

rocketbrain.java.debugBundlePath.description: Absolute path to the separately provisioned open-source Java debug JDT plugin JAR.

rocketbrain.java.hotCodeReplace.description: Allow explicitly triggered Java Hot Code Replace; no automatic source edits or code replacement.

rocketbrain.java.debugDecompiledSources.description: Use Java debugger line mappings for supported decompiled JAR classes in Java debug sessions.

rocketbrain.java.exceptionBreakpoints.description: Exception type and throw-site filters shared by Java debug sessions in this window. Use Caught or Uncaught in Run and Debug to enable the breakpoints.

exceptionTypes.description: Exact Java binary names. Includes subtypes. An empty list matches all exception types.

allowClasses.description: Throw-site class names or prefix/suffix wildcard patterns. Every listed pattern must match.

skipClasses.description: Throw-site class names or prefix/suffix wildcard patterns to exclude.

rocketbrain.java.stepFilters.description: Default per-session Java step filters. A stepFilters field in launch.json overrides the matching setting.

allowClasses.description: Restrict Java step locations to classes matching every pattern.

skipClasses.description: Exclude Java classes or packages by exact name or a leading/trailing wildcard.

skipSynthetics.description: Skip compiler-generated methods during Java step-in.

skipStaticInitializers.description: Skip Java static initializers during step-in.

rocketbrain.java.projectJdks.description: Project execution environments such as JavaSE-1.8, JavaSE-17 or JavaSE-21 with standalone JDK paths.

rocketbrain.spring.enabled.description: Enable Rocketbrain's Spring source analysis and configuration assistance.

rocketbrain.spring.activeProfiles.description: Profiles selected for static Spring analysis.

rocketbrain.spring.properties.description: Explicit property overrides for static Spring analysis.

rocketbrain.spring.basePackages.description: Optional source package boundaries for the analysis model.

rocketbrain.spring.configurationRoots.description: Explicit Spring configuration directories, relative to a workspace folder or absolute. Multiple unscoped application contexts remain uncertain.

rocketbrain.spring.closedWorld.description: Treat the selected source model as the complete bean set. Enable only for controlled projects; external auto-configuration may otherwise supply missing beans.

rocketbrain.spring.parameterNames.description: Use Java parameter names as bean-name fallback when the application is compiled with -parameters.

rocketbrain.spring.diagnostics.enabled.description: Publish diagnostics for supported Spring resolution cases; unresolved dynamic conditions remain unknown.

rocketbrain.spring.runtime.url.description: Local Actuator base URL. No request is made until Connect Local Runtime is explicitly invoked.

rocketbrain.spring.runtime.timeoutMs.description: Timeout for explicitly requested runtime observations.

rocketbrain.spring.runtime.maxResponseBy.description: Maximum bytes accepted per runtime response.

rocketbrain.jpa.enabled.description: Analyze supported JPA source mappings and JPQL references.

rocketbrain.jpa.basePackages.description: Explicit source package boundary for this JPA model; ambiguous persistence-unit bindings remain unresolved.

rocketbrain.jpa.mappingFiles.description: Optional ORM XML file paths inside workspace folders, relative or absolute. When empty, discover META-INF/orm.xml. Explicit paths replace automatic discovery; each file must be local and no larger than one MiB.

rocketbrain.jpa.diagnostics.enabled.description: Publish JPA diagnostics for supported mapping and query cases.

rocketbrain.jpa.physicalNaming.description: Explicit physical naming assumption for mapping/catalog comparison. Unknown naming does not prove a missing physical table.

physical.description: Fully qualified physical naming strategy class available in workspace source, or a supported Hibernate built-in.

implicit.description: Fully qualified implicit naming strategy class available in workspace source, or a supported Hibernate built-in.

rocketbrain.jpa.namingStrategy.description: Explicit naming configuration. A bounded source interpreter reads supported pure methods without loading Java classes. Unsupported behavior and missing profile entries remain unresolved; no automatic catalog guessing is performed.

rocketbrain.java.testing.runtimePath.description: Path to the separately provisioned java-testing-runtime.json. Empty uses the extension storage installation.

rocketbrain.java.testing.saveHistory.description: Store recent completed Java test summaries, failure messages and comparison texts in the current workspace's local extension state.

rocketbrain.java.testing.projects.description: Explicit compiled Java test project profiles. Empty resolves imported Maven/Gradle test classpaths through the independent Java language engine.

framework.description: JUnit Platform or TestNG runner; automatic resolution creates separate profiles when both are imported.

rocketbrain.sql.analysis.enabled.description: Analyze supported SQL scopes using the explicitly connected database catalog, without executing the analyzed SQL.

rocketbrain.sql.project.roots.description: Local query folders inside the workspace for bounded semantic .sql reference scans. Empty scans workspace SQL files. Unsupported migrations or SQL are reported as incomplete and block a combined source rename.

rocketbrain.sql.project.javaRoots.description: Optional local Java source folders inside the workspace for semantic usage searches in recognized native SQL literals.

rocketbrain.sql.project.renameEmbeddedJa.description: Include proven native SQL query literals in selected Java roots when reviewing source updates for a database rename.

rocketbrain.java.mavenHome.description: Optional Apache Maven home for explicit Java project tasks. Maven is not bundled.

rocketbrain.kotlinEditor.serverHome.description: Absolute server directory of the standalone open-source ktlsp 1.4.0-rc1 release.

rocketbrain.kotlinEditor.gradleUserHome.description: Optional Gradle user home for Kotlin language server classpath resolution.

rocketbrain.java.jakarta.tomcatHome.description: Absolute directory of an independently installed Apache Tomcat 11 distribution for local Jakarta WAR deployments.

rocketbrain.scala.sbtLauncher.description: Absolute path to the official sbt 1.13.1 launcher JAR for explicit Scala builds.

rocketbrain.scala.cacheDirectory.description: Optional absolute directory for the Rocketbrain sbt boot and dependency caches. Uses extension storage by default.

rocketbrain.scala.repositoryConfig.description: Optional absolute path to your sbt repository override configuration for managed tasks.

rocketbrain.kotlin.gradleHome.description: Optional independent Gradle installation for Kotlin Multiplatform actions. Falls back to the Java Gradle installation.

rocketbrain.kotlin.gradleUserHome.description: Optional Gradle user home used by Rocketbrain Kotlin Multiplatform tasks.

rocketbrain.kotlin.nodeHome.description: Optional standalone Node.js directory prepended to the Kotlin Gradle task environment when a project uses a system Node.js.

rocketbrain.spring.initializr.endpoint.description: HTTPS Spring Initializr service used for explicit metadata and project creation requests.
